@everyone Charity stream for Linden Community Pantry — Saturday, Nov 21, 10am–10pm. Goal is $600, and Rook is matching the first $100 so those donations count double. Link: lindenpantry.example/mrkz. It goes straight to the pantry, nothing taken off, and through their wholesale partner $1 gets about 4 lbs of food. They're serving around 340 families a week right now and shelves are the lowest they've been before Thanksgiving.

Incentives: $100 = I play a full round with the controller upside down. $250 = chat picks my hair dye color and I do it on stream. $400 = one hour of chat-picked songs, no skipping. $600 = I vlog a grocery pickup arranged by the pantry.

Stream plan: first half is community lobbies, anyone can join, I'll drop the code. Second half chat votes on the game every 2 hours, no repeat maps.

Even $3 helps. If you can't donate, absolutely no stress — sharing the stream/link or bringing canned/boxed food to the blue bin by the pantry's side door (Saturdays 9–1) helps too. Posting early this year because last year half the server didn't know until the day of. Pinning this so it doesn't get buried.

I get the "charity streams are cringe" thing, but this one's pretty concrete: donations go straight to Linden Community Pantry, no fees, and $1 buys about 4 lbs of food through their wholesale partner. The incentives are just me doing dumb stuff on stream — upside-down controller, chat picking my hair dye — so you're at least getting hair dye content out of it. If it's not your thing, no worries.

And for anyone without a card: you can still help by sharing the link, hanging out in stream, or dropping canned/boxed food in the blue bin by the pantry side door Saturdays 9–1. No pressure either way.
